arguments.sql:
WITH season_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM main."match"
    WHERE season_id = 5
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
    FROM main.player_match AS pm
    JOIN season_matches AS m ON m.match_id = pm.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
batting_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM season_matches AS m
    JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT w.player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out
    FROM main.wicket_taken AS w
    JOIN season_matches AS m ON m.match_id = w.match_id
    WHERE w.kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY w.player_out
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       1.0 * COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0) AS batting_average
FROM appearances AS a
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_runs AS r ON r.player_id = a.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = a.player_id
ORDER BY 1.0 * COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) / a.matches_played DESC, a.player_id
LIMIT 5

WITH season_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM main."match"
    WHERE season_id = 5
),
runs_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker AS player_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM season_matches AS m
    JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s
      ON s.match_id = b.match_id AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND s.over_id = b.over_id AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.runs, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM season_matches AS m
    JOIN main.player_match AS pm ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    LEFT JOIN runs_by_match AS r
      ON r.match_id = pm.match_id AND r.player_id = pm.player_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT w.player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out
    FROM season_matches AS m
    JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w ON w.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE w.kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY w.player_out
)
SELECT p.player_name, t.matches_played, t.total_runs, d.times_out,
       1.0 * t.total_runs / t.matches_played AS runs_per_match
FROM player_totals AS t
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = t.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = t.player_id
ORDER BY runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 6
